text:
Picture a mechanic in Osborne Park. Three weekends planning his perfect website.

Colours picked. Fonts picked. Pages live: zero.

The mechanic down the road put up one plain page for "car service Osborne Park" in an afternoon. Google can find that page.

Done beats perfect. Get the page up.

GEO. AEO. LLMO. Every month someone invents new letters for showing up on AI.

Google's own page on its AI features says you need no special tricks to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode.

Skip the new letters. Do the SEO basics properly. That's what gets you into Google's AI answers.

Power goes out at a house in Scarborough. The owner searches "electrician Scarborough" and rings one of the top three on the map.

SEO is the work that puts you in those three spots. It takes months.

What SEO means in calls for you: https://gimsresults.com.au/post/what-can-seo-do-for-my-business
